scope: Bounded independent static review of Park startup/entry launcher, pending promise sharing, readiness contract and owned-child failure paths. Raw provided test/browser evidence inspected; reviewer ran no tests, harness, service, HTTP or process-control action.
result: Two concrete findings reported promptly and now source-fixed; no remaining actionable finding in requested wrapper/integration scope.

findings.trigger: Wrapper180s timer kills demo ensure owner during lock-held detached-child preparation.
findings.impact: Owner termination bypasses its finally lock release and startup-child cleanup, leaving child market processes and stale launcher lock. Initial timeout fake closed immediately after kill and did not model descendants/lock. Combined subordinate lock90s+engine60s+UI30s+heartbeat15s budgets can exceed180s.
findings.resolution: Wrapper timer/timeoutMs/SIGTERM removed. Wrapper retains shared pending promise until actual CLI error/close and leaves transaction cleanup with CLI.
findings.validation: Final5/5 fake-child tests include retaining same pending promise and no wrapper kill before actual child close. Static absence of killing timer inspected. No destructive real timeout test run.

findings.trigger: stdout open succeeds but stderr open rejects before try/finally.
findings.impact: First FileHandle bypassed deterministic close on second-open failure.
findings.resolution: stderr declared before try, opened inside try; finally closes stdout and optional stderr.
findings.validation: Current cleanup control flow inspected. No direct second-open failure injection in five tests.

observations.conclusion: Startup and POST /api/launch?id=trading use one module singleton. Synchronous pending assignment shares exact promise across overlapping calls; finally resets only after launch settles. Separate CLI processes also serialize with demo launcher lock.

Requires CLI exit0, last JSON ok:true, permitted status, valid HTTP loopback UI/API URLs. CLI require owned engine/all12 bots, health/heartbeats, own UI log and HTTP readiness for new children. Source does not turn queue/start request into ready success.

Trading special case precedes static configured attraction URL; launch failure returns503 with error. Startup logs failure while keeping Park usable; later attraction entry calls ensure again and can retry.

Launcher now delegates stage deadlines/cleanup to CLI, not a hard end-to-end wall-clock bound. Current restore cleanup helper is bounded; existing ownedProcess Windows synchronous CIM call still has no timeout. Do not describe all CLI execution paths as hard-bounded.

unit_evidence.scope: Fake child tests; not real process timeout/tree cleanup.

actual_park_evidence.proven: Park5196 startup log Trading reused; POST launch200->5175; saved browser launch modal and connected market EVENT84615; owned testPark21732 later signaled/stopped, manifest SHA comparison unchanged.
actual_park_evidence.limits: This is existing-market reuse, not a cold full-market start or UI-only restoration via Park. It used pre-fix launcher hash9b82; final changes have newer fake-child unit evidence. Owned Park exit SIGTERM is not a clean exit0; production trading was intentionally preserved.

limits: No claim of a current-source real failure/timeout process-tree test.
No blanket hard wall-clock limit after removal of unsafe wrapper timer.
Readiness is a point-in-time CLI ownership/health check; future service liveness is not promised.
No end-to-end cold Park startup, missing-UI recovery or setup-missing browser flow is established by the inspected reuse fixture.
Park stop intentionally leaves independent trading market running; this review did not change that lifecycle policy.
